scan.title: Full Scan
scan.intro: Scans the selected drive from the root down to every file. In Fast Mode, 1 TB ≈ 5 sec (admin required); Standard Mode works everywhere. Results open in the visual map on the right.
scan.uncTitle: UNC path (\\server\share) scan — bandwidth heavy, use carefully
scan.uncDialogHelp: Enter an SMB/NAS network share path. SMB metadata is heavy so this is slower than local scans.

drilldown.title: Folder View
drilldown.intro: A visual map of the current folder. Click a slice/cell to drill in; use the path strip above to step back out. Colors show each file's 'safe to delete' score — red = don't touch, green = easy to delete.
drilldown.lodHidden: {count} small files hidden for performance (LOD filter)
drilldown.mode3DTitle: 3D layered sunburst — drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, click to drill

staging.title: Pending Deletes
staging.subtitle: Think of it like a trash can — but capped at 24 hours, with no auto-cleanup
staging.intro: Nothing you delete disappears immediately: it waits here for 24 hours. Realized it was a mistake? Hit ↩ Undo. For things you're sure about, use 🔥 to delete forever (double confirmation required). Expired items stay until you act on them — you stay in control.
staging.empty: Nothing deleted yet. Pick a file from the map on the left → use 📥 in the side panel to delete it (recoverable for 24h).
staging.permTitle: Delete forever (double confirmation, cannot be undone)
staging.permWarn: ⚠ This cannot be undone; the file is gone forever and an audit-log entry is written. To confirm, type the exact file name:
staging.secureWipeHint: Protects against forensic recovery; takes 2-3× longer. Not 100% guaranteed on SSDs (wear leveling).
staging.expiredIntro: {count} items in the staging queue have passed their 24-hour undo window. Per Section 22.6 they were NOT deleted automatically — they live on until you approve. You can permanently delete all of them at once or review one by one.
staging.expiredConfirmHelp: Section 12.2.3 — rate limit 20 files/s, each one is recorded in the forensic ledger. This cannot be undone. Confirm to proceed.
staging.abortedThreshold: ⚠ {count} items exceeded the threshold — automatic cleanup was aborted. Review the list and confirm.

snapshot.title: Time Machine
snapshot.intro: After a scan, capture the current state with 📸. Subsequent scans show comparative deltas — which folders grew/shrunk, what was added/removed.
snapshot.empty: No snapshots yet. After a scan, hit 📸 to capture — daily growth/shrink delta comes from here.
snapshot.compareHint: Select two snapshots to compare (old → new).

duplicate.title: Duplicate Files
duplicate.intro: Finds files with identical content (Blake3 hash match). Run a scan first, then pick a minimum size filter here to see reclaimable disk space.
duplicate.needsScan: Run a full scan first. Identical files are detected via size + hash match; the actual reclaimable space is reported here.
duplicate.hashErrorsTitle: These files were held open by another process. With VSS build feature enabled, this error drops.
duplicate.truncatedTitle: Found {total} groups total; showing top {shown} for performance. Tighten the filter to see all.

detail.title: Selected Item
detail.intro: Click a file in the map on the left — size, last-modified, safety score, and quick actions appear here.
detail.empty: Pick a file from the map on the left → details open here.
detail.indexNote: USN index search result — full path resolved from the backend.

conflict.title: Conflict: {name}
conflict.help: Section 12.2.4 — a different file already exists at the target path. Which one do you want to keep?

lock.ownerEmpty: Owner not detected (RestartManager found no process — may be a kernel handle).

onboarding.slide1Body: Maps your 1 TB SSD in seconds. Reads the NTFS MFT directly — Sunburst, Treemap, Bubble, Timeline.
onboarding.slide2Body: 53 built-in rules assign a 0-100 "how safe to delete" score to every folder. node_modules safe (95), pagefile.sys never touch (3).
onboarding.slide3Body: No deletion is immediate. Moved to a staging folder, recoverable for 24h. Cross-volume two-phase commit, conflict resolution, forensic ledger.
onboarding.modeHelp: D-Space uses a two-tier scan strategy. Pick the one that fits — you can change it later via Diagnostics.
onboarding.modeFastB3: No UAC prompt on first launch (Tier 1)
onboarding.compareIntro: There are popular tools in the disk-analysis space. Each has strengths; D-Space aims for the speed + safety + AI-score trio.
onboarding.compareDisclaimer: ✓ = yes · ○ = partial · — = no · *WizTree free non-commercial. Data as of 2026-05; may change with vendor releases.

shortcuts.title: ⌨ Keyboard Shortcuts (Section 15.2)
shortcuts.viewModes: View mode — Sunburst · Treemap · Bubble · Timeline · 3D
shortcuts.stageDelete: Send the first file in viewport to staging
shortcuts.hint: Shortcuts are disabled while an input/textarea has focus — normal typing is not blocked.

sidebar.title: Drives
sidebar.hwTypicalRead: Typical read speed from bus type (not a real benchmark)

trayMonitor.title: Disk Usage Monitor
trayMonitor.intro: When enabled, D-Space checks your drives' usage every N minutes in the background; if any exceeds the threshold, you get a reminder. No scanning, no user data read — only total/free bytes.

update.restartHint: The app will restart once installation completes
update.errorVerify: Signature verification failed — package corrupted or pubkey mismatch

driveWarning.refs: ReFS drive: direct MFT reading is not supported — Standard Mode will be used (Section 5.5).
driveWarning.unknownFs: Unknown file system ({fs}) — Standard Mode will be attempted.
driveWarning.remote: Network drive: high bandwidth and privilege cost (Section 33.3). Scanning may be slow.
driveWarning.removable: Removable media: remember to safely eject after the scan (Section 33.4).
driveWarning.cdrom: Optical media: read-only, staging/deletion is not possible.

userRules.title: User Rules (Section 6.4)
userRules.intro: Evaluated BEFORE the built-in rules. Assign a score to any folder/extension with your own pattern; takes effect after the next scan.
